items.title: Object to Kinderzuschlag decision (Widerspruch)
items.quote: Innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe kann gegen diesen Bescheid Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei: Familienkasse Musterlahn, Bahnhofsallee 40, 35576 Beispielwetzlar.
items.computation: Posting day = date on the Bescheid, 20.11.2026 (Fri); no separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post' is stated, so the document date is used as the posting day. Letters posted on/after 1 Jan 2025 count as delivered on the 4th day after posting: 21.11 (Sat), 22.11 (Sun), 23.11 (Mon), 24.11 (Tue) -> delivered 24.11.2026. The Familienkasse acting on a Kinderzuschlag (BKGG) matter is treated like other social-law bodies (§37 Abs.2 SGB X), so the delivery day is NOT shifted even though it falls partly over a weekend sequence (here the 4th day itself, 24.11.2026, is a Tuesday anyway, so no issue arises). The one-month Widerspruch period starts the day after delivery (§187 Abs.1 BGB) and ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day (§188 Abs.2 BGB): 24.11.2026 + 1 month = 24.12.2026. 24 December is explicitly a normal working day under German law and 2026-12-24 is a Thursday, so no weekend/holiday shift (§26 Abs.3 SGB X) is needed. Final deadline: 24.12.2026.
